מה? גם לגברים יש רצפת-אגן? כל מי שהתעניי: What? Men have a pelvic floor too? Everyone who has ever asked about my profession has been "surprised" to discover that men also have a "pelvic floor", and in fact <mark class="hl">a third of my patients are men</mark>.
לצערי, המודעות לנושא רצפת האגן אצל גברים: Unfortunately, awareness of the male pelvic floor is still not enough – and few doctors are familiar with the subject and with how effective physiotherapy is in the various conditions related to male pelvic floor health. So what do men mainly suffer from?
<strong class=\"t-panel__term\">הבעיה שס:
The problem with the lowest awareness is also the most painful – pelvic floor pain
The pain may appear in the genital area – the penis, the perineum (the area between the testicles and the anus), the rectum, the anus, around the bladder, in the groin, the lower abdomen, the hips, the lower back or the tailbone, on one side of the body or on both. Alongside the pain there may also be urinary problems, such as discomfort, pain or burning when urinating, urinary urgency, a weak urine stream, frequent urination at night, or problems and difficulties emptying the bowels up to severe constipation, back pain, inguinal hernia and more. In sexual function there may be discomfort during or after ejaculation, and sometimes also problems getting or keeping an erection.
בדרך כלל גברים הסובלים מכאבים עברו כמעט: Men with this pain have usually been through almost every possible relevant medical test (urine, blood, ultrasound, prostate and more), and all were found normal. The pain is sometimes labeled "chronic prostatitis" (= chronic inflammation of the prostate) and sometimes even treated with antibiotics, in vain.

ניתן לטפל בהצלחה בבריחת צואה וגזים! - טי: Fecal and gas incontinence can be treated successfully! - Physiotherapy for fecal leakage
ההגדרה \"דליפת צואה\" מתייחסת לבריחה לא: The term "fecal leakage" refers to the involuntary loss of stool (whether hard or soft) or of gas. Of all the problems related to the pelvic floor this is perhaps the most embarrassing, condemning those who suffer from it to social isolation and a lower quality of life.
&nbsp;למרות הפגיעה הקשה באיכות החיים, רק: Despite the serious effect on quality of life, only a third of patients with loss of bowel control and fecal leakage seek treatment – many do not know the problem can be treated successfully, and go on suffering because they see it as taboo. Loss of control over stool or gas may stem from a problem in the bowel, the rectum or the anus, or from a combination of several factors.
מצבים העלולים לעודד נזקים שיובילו לחוסר: Conditions that may cause damage leading to loss of bowel control:
לידות קשות, ניתוחים, עצירות כרונית ולחיצ: Difficult births, surgery, chronic constipation and straining when emptying, fistula, abscess, diseases of the blood vessels or the nervous system, local trauma and more. טיפול בעצירות ובעצירות כרונית- טיפול יעי: Treatment for constipation and chronic constipation - an effective, easy treatment for real relief
קיים מגוון שלם של הרגלי התרוקנות הנחשבים: There is a whole range of bowel habits that are considered normal. Although a large part of the population empties once a day, the norm ranges from 3 times a day to once every three days. Constipation can be caused by one or more of the following:
תזונה או שתיה לקויה: Poor diet or not drinking enough
תנועתיות מופחתת של המעיים (=זמן מעבר הצו: Reduced bowel motility (= slow stool transit time)
קושי פונקציונלי להתרוקן (עקב חוסר תיאום: Functional difficulty emptying (due to poor coordination between the rectum and the anus, or over-contraction of the anal canal)
כיצד נדע אם אנו סובלים מעצירות?: How do we know if we are constipated?
אם מתקיים אחד או יותר מהתנאים הבאים:: If one or more of the following applies:
תדירות ההתרוקנות נמוכה מ- 3 פעמים בשבוע: Emptying less than 3 times a week
נדרש מאמץ רב על מנת להתרוקן: A lot of straining is needed to empty
<strong>מצב מתמשך של עצירות לצד מאמצים ק: Long-term constipation together with hard straining to empty will, over time, weaken the pelvic floor and may also cause hemorrhoids, a fissure (a tear in the anus), urinary leakage or pelvic organ prolapse. Pelvic floor physiotherapy is an effective, easy treatment for constipation and chronic constipation.
